name: University of Warwick
header:
University of Warwick
United Kingdom · Mathematics MPhil/PhD (CDT); Mathematics MSc, with optional preliminary diploma year
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Bachelor’s-only direct PhD eligibility requires an equivalence decision; four US undergraduate years do not
themselves equal an integrated UK master’s.
• University scholarship letters technically have a later deadline, but reviewers may start before that grace
period ends.
• Department funding lasts four years; some university scholarships last only three and a half.
• Do not infer an available 2027 MASt intake from old contact-page labels.
• David Loeffler and Sarah Zerbes have honorary/visiting listings; John Cremona and David Mond are emeriti.
They are not treated here as ordinary available supervisors. Relevant shortlist is broad but does not certify
every faculty member’s 2027 capacity.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
MSc: first-class-equivalent mathematics or mathematically intensive science bachelor’s. PhD: first-class
integrated four-year master’s or first-class bachelor’s plus distinction-level MSc, or overseas equivalent. A US
four-year bachelor’s is not explicitly guaranteed to meet the integrated-master’s requirement; ask for
individual equivalence before relying on direct entry. MSc is the clearly documented bachelor’s-entry route. F-1
status does not determine UK admission or Home fee status. Programme begins 4 October 2027; PhD initially
registers as MPhil with first-year upgrade. [s1] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Review preparation against Warwick fourth-year mathematics; choose one-year MSc or diploma plus MSc if
further preparation needed. PhD: identify interests and possible supervisors; prior supervisor agreement is not
required. Apply to Mathematics Institute, postgraduate research, code P-G1P4. For university funding submit
course application first, wait for seven-digit ID (up to 48 hours), register ITS, then submit separate scholarship
form. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s14]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Identify possible supervisors but prior agreement is not required for ordinary PhD. Individual research pages
may invite contact; Dervan specifically welcomes prospective PhD contact around November of the preceding
year. Faculty below are a verified relevant shortlist; availability to supervise in 2027 must be checked
individually. [s1] [s2] [s16] [s17]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Submit course form, receive acknowledgement and ID, register ITS (normally up to two working days), then use
Applicant Portal to upload documents, track progress, change referees, resend requests and respond to offers.
University scholarship is a separate portal and becomes uneditable after submission; imports may show a
PDF-view error that the guidance says does not affect assessment. [s6] [s13]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
2027 PhD/MSc courses and funding are published. Scholarship guidance updated 4 November 2026 is

particularly current. Current master’s pages list MSc and diploma-plus-MSc; older staff contacts still mention
MASt, but a live 2027 MASt admissions route was not verified. [s1] [s4] [s6] [s9] [s14]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Conflict]
Doctoral department admits on a rolling basis, but university-scholarship applicants must submit course
application by 7 December 2026, 16:59 GMT. Central 2027 deadline for applicants needing a visa is 2 August
2027; department FAQ advises unfunded visa applicants by end of June. Treat June as the safer planning target
and ask about the discrepancy. MSc central on-time deadline is 2 August 2027; late consideration is
discretionary, not guaranteed. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s10]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Department-led doctoral funding: rolling, no fixed closing date, early application encouraged. University PGR
scholarships: separate scholarship application 10 December 2026, 16:59 GMT, preceded by course deadline
above. Martingale closed 18 October 2026; US-citizen Fulbright closed 6 October 2026. [s4] [s5]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
University scholarships: 21 December 2026, 16:59 GMT, but assessment begins immediately after 10
December and references received after assessment starts may not reach reviewers. Aim to have both letters
in by 10 December. No separate universal doctoral/MSc letter deadline established outside scholarship
processing. [s6]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
No separate fixed test-score date found; meet any English condition in the offer and in time for visa processing.
University scholarship document deadline does not establish that an English condition must already be cleared.
[s1] [s6] [s8]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
University scholarship documents other than references: 10 December 2026, 16:59 GMT, through the correct
course/scholarship channel. Ordinary application should include current transcripts and required supporting
material; final degree conditions and deadlines are offer-specific. [s6] [s10]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No common public acceptance date verified; respond through Applicant Portal by the deadline in each
admission/funding offer. University scholarship offers are scheduled for 5 March 2027, with intermediate
notification 25 January, neither is a commitment deadline. [s5] [s13]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Band A for both routes: IELTS 6.5 overall, minimum 6.0 each component, or accepted equivalent. Tests must
be within two years and one month of course start; use most recent result. [s1] [s8] [s9]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Potential degree-based satisfaction: entire degree taught in English in a UKVI-recognised
majority-English-speaking country and completed within two years four months before course start. A recent
UChicago degree fits the published country/medium pattern, but the department retains discretion and may
impose an English condition. Confirm exact graduation timing and provide transcript/degree evidence. [s8]

scores are considered, forbidden, or beneficial. Do not treat absence as a recommendation to submit. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
PhD: two academic references. MSc: normally one academic reference. As a recent full-time undergraduate,
use academics who directly taught or supervised your academic work; friends, peers, relatives and school
teachers are not accepted. [s1] [s7] [s9]
Scholarship references [2027 confirmed]
For a new 2027 applicant the university scholarship uses the course letters and sends no extra invitations,
even though the scholarship form asks for referee details. Tell writers their letters also support scholarship
assessment of readiness and research potential. Separate scholarship-triggered references apply only to
existing Warwick PGR students applying for CSC, not this applicant. [s6]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Automatic invitation occurs after submission of the course application and payment of any assessment fee.
Merely entering details does not trigger it. Warwick sends the initial request once; applicant can resend from
portal. [s7] [s13]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, ordinary automated requests follow course submission. Postal signed originals with official letterhead and
reference form are listed as an alternative in central guidance; that page says email references are not
accepted. Use the online channel as the current practical route. [s7]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
Portal tracks progress, missing actions and uploaded documents and supports reference resends. The public
central guide does not explicitly establish a distinct letter-received confirmation/email; check the application
status and ask Admissions if uncertain. [s13]
Updating and reusing letters [Conflict]
Portal permits adding/changing referee details and resending requests. For deferred 2027/28 applicants,
previous documents and references remain available; updated letters may be sent to
pgreferences@warwick.ac.uk with name, student ID and deferred-application explanation (specific exception to
general no-email rule). Post-submission writer replacement for an ordinary new application and reuse across
distinct courses are unverified. [s6] [s7] [s13]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
PhD: CV required in departmental checklist; upload in personal-statement section. No public page/word limit or
font requirement found. MSc central list says CV if applicable, not a verified programme-specific mandatory CV.
Do not upload CV to university scholarship: its assessors do not review it. [s2] [s6] [s10]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
A personal/academic statement is required. Faithful paraphrase: explain preparation, interests and motivation
for this course. Central taught-course advice suggests approximately one to two pages, English and own
words; this is not established as a hard PhD limit. Upload; exact file format/size unverified. [s2] [s10] [s12]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate US-style background/diversity statement identified for ordinary Mathematics admission; personal
statement above is the main application essay. Scholarship has a separate optional circumstances response,
detailed below. [s2] [s6] [s10]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
PhD statement/proposal should identify areas, what you have learned, why they interest you, and relevant
projects/thesis; potential supervisor names are welcome. A settled research project is not required. No public
length or formatting limit found. [s1] [s2]
Research proposal [Conflict]
Department checklist lists a proposal, but FAQ explicitly permits broad interests and re-uploading the personal
statement into the proposal slot. Thus a detailed project proposal is not mandatory for ordinary PhD admission.
University funding requires its own project-and-place answer and may need stronger specificity. MSc proposal
not listed. [s2] [s3] [s6]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
No thesis, writing sample or separate research summary upload required by the public ordinary checklist;
mention relevant projects in the statement. Optional-paper upload/link permission and any limits unverified.
[s2] [s10]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate publications list or paper upload requirement found. Include relevant work within CV if
appropriate; public sources do not establish permission to append full papers or substitute links. [s2] [s10]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics-course list or course-description document identified in the public mathematics
checklist. Transcript provides courses; additional upload permission, template and limits are unverified. [s2]
[s10]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
University PGR form, faithful paraphrase: researcher achievements/experience/skills/motivation/readiness,
≤500 words; research title/question, 20 words; project and fit with Warwick, ≤800 words. Use plain English for
a broad academic panel, no bibliography required. Optional scheme-specific answers ≤300 words each for
interdisciplinary fit, Pathway eligibility and CSC eligibility; enter N/A for unrequested schemes because every
box requires a response. Additional unassessed circumstances/support-needs answer ≤300 words;
funding-stream opt-outs and own-work declaration. Enter form responses; scholarship assessors do not see
course CV or full proposal. Full prompt at official guidance. [s6]
Other short answers / materials [2027 confirmed]
No other ordinary mathematics essays identified publicly. Sanctuary scholarship requires evidence of eligible
Home Office status; CSC and joint schemes have extra eligibility/document rules. Scholarship form cannot be
edited after submission; submission confirmation contains review link. [s6]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Department: full tuition plus published annual stipend £21,805 for 2027/28, laptop, £2,000 travel and £2,000
third-year study-visit support. Figure is quoted exactly from the opened department page, not silently replaced
by a different indexed figure or an assumed UKRI rate; payment frequency and health/visa cover not stated.
Central Chancellor’s streams: UKRI-rate stipend (2027 cash amount not independently fixed here), full fees,
£5,000 research/training support; possible international immigration-cost assistance. MSc has no general
stipend guarantee established. [s4] [s5]
Years of support [2027 confirmed]
Department mathematics CDT support: four years subject to satisfactory performance. Faculty and
interdisciplinary Chancellor’s: normally 3.5 years. Sanctuary and CSC streams: four years under respective
terms. Do not assume all Warwick awards have identical duration. [s4] [s5]
International eligibility [2027 confirmed]
Department studentships explicitly open to overseas students and cover full overseas fees, but international
places are limited by cost. Chancellor’s competitions welcome all nationalities. CSC requires its
nationality/status eligibility; US Fulbright citizenship is not conferred by US study/F-1. Sanctuary relates to UK
protection/asylum status, not ordinary F-1 status. [s4] [s5]
Conditions and duties [2027 confirmed]
Awards are competitive; departmental renewal requires satisfactory progress. University competition requires
departmental nomination and a course offer before scholarship offer. CSC has separate eligibility and a 21
January 2027 course-offer condition, subject to stated limited exceptions; seek individual advice if relevant. [s4]
[s5] [s6]
Extra funding application [2027 confirmed]
Department-led funding automatic unless applicant declares already-secured separate funding; indicate a
specific project if desired. University funding requires its separate single scholarship application after course
submission, ID and ITS setup; documents and references import automatically. [s4] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Department advertises Tim Austin’s probability/ergodic/representation project, other grant-funded projects,
university Chancellor’s and access schemes, CSC, Monash-Warwick and Shanghai Jiao Tong joint opportunities.
Eligibility and joint-supervision obligations differ. Martingale and Fulbright 2027-entry deadlines already passed
as stated above. Home-country funding is encouraged. No general funded MSc guarantee located. [s4] [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
PhD research application: no assessment fee. Taught master’s: £75, non-refundable, payable before
submission unless waiver approved. [s3] [s10] [s11]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
For MSc, request within the application before submission; exceptional grounds described include war-affected
circumstances or full scholarship/loan sponsorship, naming the award. Generic financial hardship without
qualifying circumstances, family funding and ordinary employer sponsorship are not generally accepted
grounds. No fee for PhD, so no waiver needed. Current portal adjudication controls. [s11]

University of Warwick
United Kingdom · Mathematics MPhil/PhD (CDT); Mathematics MSc, with optional preliminary diploma year
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Bachelor’s-only direct PhD eligibility requires an equivalence decision; four US undergraduate years do not
themselves equal an integrated UK master’s.
• University scholarship letters technically have a later deadline, but reviewers may start before that grace
period ends.
• Department funding lasts four years; some university scholarships last only three and a half.
• Do not infer an available 2027 MASt intake from old contact-page labels.
• David Loeffler and Sarah Zerbes have honorary/visiting listings; John Cremona and David Mond are emeriti.
They are not treated here as ordinary available supervisors. Relevant shortlist is broad but does not certify
every faculty member’s 2027 capacity.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
MSc: first-class-equivalent mathematics or mathematically intensive science bachelor’s. PhD: first-class
integrated four-year master’s or first-class bachelor’s plus distinction-level MSc, or overseas equivalent. A US
four-year bachelor’s is not explicitly guaranteed to meet the integrated-master’s requirement; ask for
individual equivalence before relying on direct entry. MSc is the clearly documented bachelor’s-entry route. F-1
status does not determine UK admission or Home fee status. Programme begins 4 October 2027; PhD initially
registers as MPhil with first-year upgrade. [s1] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Review preparation against Warwick fourth-year mathematics; choose one-year MSc or diploma plus MSc if
further preparation needed. PhD: identify interests and possible supervisors; prior supervisor agreement is not
required. Apply to Mathematics Institute, postgraduate research, code P-G1P4. For university funding submit
course application first, wait for seven-digit ID (up to 48 hours), register ITS, then submit separate scholarship
form. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s14]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Identify possible supervisors but prior agreement is not required for ordinary PhD. Individual research pages
may invite contact; Dervan specifically welcomes prospective PhD contact around November of the preceding
year. Faculty below are a verified relevant shortlist; availability to supervise in 2027 must be checked
individually. [s1] [s2] [s16] [s17]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Submit course form, receive acknowledgement and ID, register ITS (normally up to two working days), then use
Applicant Portal to upload documents, track progress, change referees, resend requests and respond to offers.
University scholarship is a separate portal and becomes uneditable after submission; imports may show a
PDF-view error that the guidance says does not affect assessment. [s6] [s13]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
2027 PhD/MSc courses and funding are published. Scholarship guidance updated 4 November 2026 is

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Conflict]
Doctoral department admits on a rolling basis, but university-scholarship applicants must submit course
application by 7 December 2026, 16:59 GMT. Central 2027 deadline for applicants needing a visa is 2 August
2027; department FAQ advises unfunded visa applicants by end of June. Treat June as the safer planning target
and ask about the discrepancy. MSc central on-time deadline is 2 August 2027; late consideration is
discretionary, not guaranteed. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s10]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Department-led doctoral funding: rolling, no fixed closing date, early application encouraged. University PGR
scholarships: separate scholarship application 10 December 2026, 16:59 GMT, preceded by course deadline
above. Martingale closed 18 October 2026; US-citizen Fulbright closed 6 October 2026. [s4] [s5]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
University scholarships: 21 December 2026, 16:59 GMT, but assessment begins immediately after 10
December and references received after assessment starts may not reach reviewers. Aim to have both letters
in by 10 December. No separate universal doctoral/MSc letter deadline established outside scholarship
processing. [s6]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
No separate fixed test-score date found; meet any English condition in the offer and in time for visa processing.
University scholarship document deadline does not establish that an English condition must already be cleared.
[s1] [s6] [s8]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
University scholarship documents other than references: 10 December 2026, 16:59 GMT, through the correct
course/scholarship channel. Ordinary application should include current transcripts and required supporting
material; final degree conditions and deadlines are offer-specific. [s6] [s10]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No common public acceptance date verified; respond through Applicant Portal by the deadline in each
admission/funding offer. University scholarship offers are scheduled for 5 March 2027, with intermediate
notification 25 January, neither is a commitment deadline. [s5] [s13]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Band A for both routes: IELTS 6.5 overall, minimum 6.0 each component, or accepted equivalent. Tests must
be within two years and one month of course start; use most recent result. [s1] [s8] [s9]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]

Pay attention to
• Bachelor’s-only direct PhD eligibility requires an equivalence decision; four US undergraduate years do not
themselves equal an integrated UK master’s.
• University scholarship letters technically have a later deadline, but reviewers may start before that grace
period ends.
• Department funding lasts four years; some university scholarships last only three and a half.
• Do not infer an available 2027 MASt intake from old contact-page labels.
• David Loeffler and Sarah Zerbes have honorary/visiting listings; John Cremona and David Mond are emeriti.

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
MSc: first-class-equivalent mathematics or mathematically intensive science bachelor’s. PhD: first-class
integrated four-year master’s or first-class bachelor’s plus distinction-level MSc, or overseas equivalent. A US
four-year bachelor’s is not explicitly guaranteed to meet the integrated-master’s requirement; ask for
individual equivalence before relying on direct entry. MSc is the clearly documented bachelor’s-entry route. F-1
status does not determine UK admission or Home fee status. Programme begins 4 October 2027; PhD initially
registers as MPhil with first-year upgrade. [s1] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Review preparation against Warwick fourth-year mathematics; choose one-year MSc or diploma plus MSc if
further preparation needed. PhD: identify interests and possible supervisors; prior supervisor agreement is not
required. Apply to Mathematics Institute, postgraduate research, code P-G1P4. For university funding submit
course application first, wait for seven-digit ID (up to 48 hours), register ITS, then submit separate scholarship
form. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s14]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Identify possible supervisors but prior agreement is not required for ordinary PhD. Individual research pages
may invite contact; Dervan specifically welcomes prospective PhD contact around November of the preceding
year. Faculty below are a verified relevant shortlist; availability to supervise in 2027 must be checked
individually. [s1] [s2] [s16] [s17]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Submit course form, receive acknowledgement and ID, register ITS (normally up to two working days), then use
Applicant Portal to upload documents, track progress, change referees, resend requests and respond to offers.
University scholarship is a separate portal and becomes uneditable after submission; imports may show a
PDF-view error that the guidance says does not affect assessment. [s6] [s13]

2027 PhD/MSc courses and funding are published. Scholarship guidance updated 4 November 2026 is

particularly current. Current master’s pages list MSc and diploma-plus-MSc; older staff contacts still mention
MASt, but a live 2027 MASt admissions route was not verified. [s1] [s4] [s6] [s9] [s14]
